title: Concept: SQL Server client exception text disclosed in a response
description: A SqlClient exception carries the server, database and instance name, and the stack frame that follows names the application assembly and its build path. That combination gives an attacker the internal topology and the software identity in one response.
applicability: Responses generated by a .NET or classic ASP application backed by SQL Server.
risk: The caller learns the SQL Server instance, database name and application assembly path, which is the reconnaissance needed to target a second-stage attack or a path traversal.
